pairs.target: líkāi fēng zhàn qián de yìtiān , tǎ wéi méiyǒu zài qù liáng dìèrzhī tuōjià .
pairs.english: The day before leaving Wind Trestle, Tavi didn't measure the second cradle again.
pairs.hanzi: 离开风栈前的一天，塔维没有再去量第二只托架。

pairs.target: tā jiāng wēn xiù wèn guò de nà zǔ shù zhǎoqí , chāo míng nǎ yícì liáng shí mùliào hái méi páo guò , biàn shōu le bǐ . tā bǎ zhǐ yā zài dǐ kuàngshàng , shuō huílái ruò chǐcùn biàn le , bié ná jiù shù mà tā .
pairs.english: He gathered the measurements Wenxiu had requested, noting which preceded planing, then put his pen away. She weighted the paper on the base frame and said not to blame her with old numbers if dimensions changed before his return.
pairs.hanzi: 他将温岫问过的那组数找齐，抄明哪一次量时木料还没刨过，便收了笔。她把纸压在底框上，说回来若尺寸变了，别拿旧数骂她。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ búhuì , dù chéng cóng wūlǐ jiē yíjù , nà biàn liú zhe mà mùtou .
pairs.english: Tavi said he wouldn't. Du Cheng called from inside: save the blame for the wood, then.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己不会，杜澄从屋里接一句，那便留着骂木头。

pairs.target: cìrì zǎochén , tāmen zuò shàng wǎng nán de gōnglù chē . xià róng yǐjīng jiāng zìjǐ de jíjiàn jiāogěi lìng yíwèi shāoxìn rén , zhèng dūn zài chēxíng ménbiān xì jiù xiédài .
pairs.english: The next morning they boarded the southbound road cart. Xiarong had handed her urgent parcel to another carrier and was crouching by the transport office door tying her old laces.
pairs.hanzi: 次日早晨，他们坐上往南的公路车。夏绒已经将自己的急件交给另一位捎信人，正蹲在车行门边系旧鞋带。

pairs.target: tā xuǎn de kuān xiédài hái méi mǎi dào , dǎjié shí gùyì cháo tǎ wéi jǔ le jǔ , shuō tā wèn de jià méi jiào tā bái děng , xià tàng chē biàn néngdài huílái .
pairs.english: Her chosen wider laces weren't bought yet. She deliberately raised the knot at Tavi, saying his price inquiry hadn't kept her waiting for nothing; the next cart could bring them.
pairs.hanzi: 她选的宽鞋带还没买到，打结时故意朝塔维举了举，说他问的价没叫她白等，下趟车便能带回来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn tā jīnrì bù chūmén ? tā shuō xiàwǔ wǎng lìng yìtiáo lù zǒu , bié xiǎng tíqián qǐng tā tì shuí rènlù . tǎ wéi xiào zhe tóng tā dàobié , jiāng shuǐnáng fàngdào jiǎo biān , méiyǒu zài bǎ měijiàn xiǎodōngxī dōu cóng bēibāo lǐ tāochū lái chá yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng asked if she wasn't going out today. She said she was taking another road that afternoon, so don't try booking her as anyone's guide. Tavi laughed goodbye, set his water bag by his feet, and didn't unpack every little item for another check.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问她今日不出门？她说下午往另一条路走，别想提前请她替谁认路。塔维笑着同她道别，将水囊放到脚边，没有再把每件小东西都从背包里掏出来查一遍。

pairs.target: chē guò le tái jǐng de chàlù , lùmiàn kāishǐ tiēzhe shānpō mànmàn jiàng .
pairs.english: Past the Moss Well fork, the road began descending slowly along the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 车过了苔井的岔路，路面开始贴着山坡慢慢降。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū nà kuài qíngtiān néng xiē de shítou , zhèhuí méi zuòshàngqù , zhī gé zhe chē biān kànjiàn yíjiàn shài zài shàngtóu de qīngyī .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the fair-weather resting stone; this time he only saw from the cart a blue-green garment drying on it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出那块晴天能歇的石头，这回没坐上去，只隔着车边看见一件晒在上头的青衣。

pairs.target: zài wǎng nán , wūyán bǐ fēng zhàn kuān , chuāng biān yǒurén jiàqǐ xì zhútiáo , liàngzhe qièkāi de guǒzǐ . gǎnchē de rén mǎi le yíchuàn , xiān wèn tāmen chī buchī suān , ruǎn héng dá dé tài kuài , jiáo dào dìèrkǒu biàn búzài shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Farther south, eaves were wider than Wind Trestle's. Cut fruit dried on thin bamboo strips by windows. The driver bought a string, asking if they liked sour things. Ruan Heng answered too quickly and stopped talking by his second mouthful.
pairs.hanzi: 再往南，屋檐比风栈宽，窗边有人架起细竹条，晾着切开的果子。赶车的人买了一串，先问他们吃不吃酸，阮衡答得太快，嚼到第二口便不再说话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shì le yípiàn , suān dé liǎngjiá fājǐn , què yòu xiǎng chī . chēfū shuō ruò měigè rén dōu zhèyàng , jiù búbì hǎn dìèrhuí .
pairs.english: Tavi tried a piece, sour enough to tighten his cheeks, yet wanted more. The driver said if everyone was like that he wouldn't need to ask twice.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维试了一片，酸得两颊发紧，却又想吃。车夫说若每个人都这样，就不必喊第二回。

pairs.target: tā de chē búshì zhuānsòng rén qù kàn jǐng de , lùshang háiyào jiāo liǎngdài zhǒngzi , tíng zài yìjiā yuàn wài shí , ràng tǎ wéi xiān bǎ tuǐ shōuhuí lái , hǎo cóng zuò xià chōuchū dàikǒu .
pairs.english: His cart wasn't just for sightseeing; he also had two sacks of seed to deliver. At a courtyard stop he had Tavi draw in his legs to pull the sack opening from beneath the seat.
pairs.hanzi: 他的车不是专送人去看景的，路上还要交两袋种子，停在一家院外时，让塔维先把腿收回来，好从座下抽出袋口。

pairs.target: yígènánhái cóng mén lǐ pǎo chūlái , jiē búzhù zhěngdài , biàn xiānbào zhe kǒu shéng .
pairs.english: A boy ran out the door, unable to catch the whole sack, and held its tie cord instead.
pairs.hanzi: 一个男孩从门里跑出来，接不住整袋，便先抱着口绳。

pairs.target: wūlǐ de nǚrén méiyǒu jiào tā chěngqiáng , jiāng dàizǐ tuō jìnmén biān de yīnchù , xiè guò chēfū , suíhòu wèn shàngtóu de yǔ shìfǒu tíng le .
pairs.english: The woman inside didn't make him strain. She dragged the sack into shade by the door, thanked the driver, and asked if the rain higher up had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里的女人没有叫他逞强，将袋子拖进门边的阴处，谢过车夫，随后问上头的雨是否停了。

pairs.target: chēfū shuō fēng zhàn qiánjǐrì yǐ néng zǒu , biéchù bùgǎn tìrén dá . tǎ wéi tīng zhe , méiyǒu bǎ zhè yíjù lìngjì chéng zhěngtiáolù dōu yǐ fàngqíng .
pairs.english: The driver said Wind Trestle had been passable for days but he couldn't answer for elsewhere. Tavi listened without turning this into a record of fine weather along the entire road.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫说风栈前几日已能走，别处不敢替人答。塔维听着，没有把这一句另记成整条路都已放晴。

pairs.target: wǔhòu yuǎnchù de shuǐ jiànjiàn xiǎn chūlái . qǐxiān zhī xiàng shānào lǐ yídào huī liàng de bā , zhuǎnguò wān , jìng yǒu bàngè pō nàme kuān .
pairs.english: That afternoon distant water gradually appeared. At first it was a gray-bright scar in a hollow; round a bend it was half a hillside wide.
pairs.hanzi: 午后远处的水渐渐显出来。起先只像山坳里一道灰亮的疤，转过弯，竟有半个坡那么宽。

pairs.target: jìnchù háishì tián , niú zhàn zài qiǎnshuǐ lǐ , mànmàn jiāng tóu zhuǎnxiàng chēzi .
pairs.english: Nearby were still fields, a cow standing in shallow water, slowly turning its head toward the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 近处还是田，牛站在浅水里，慢慢将头转向车子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi shuǐ yào cóng tiángěng lǐ yǒngchūlái , chēfū shuō nà yípiàn běnlái biàn liú zuò guànshuǐ de dī tián , rén zǒu pángbiān de gāo lù , bùnéng wàngjiàn shuǐ duō jiù shuō lù duàn .
pairs.english: Tavi thought water would spill over the banks. The driver said those low fields were meant for irrigation; people took the raised road beside them. Plenty of water didn't mean a road was cut.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为水要从田埂里涌出来，车夫说那一片本来便留作灌水的低田，人走旁边的高路，不能望见水多就说路断。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng tīngjiàn , zhēngkāiyǎn xiào le yíxià , méi gēnzhe tiān huà . tǎ wéi yě xiào , suíhòu xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài bái lǎoshī táizi biān jiǎng yào qù kàn shuǐ , jiǎng dé dǎoxiàng shuǐ huì guāiguāi dài zài yìzhāng túlǐ , děng tā xiàchē láikàn .
pairs.english: Hearing this, Ruan Heng opened his eyes and smiled without adding anything. Tavi smiled too, remembering how he'd told Instructor Bai he would see the water, as though it would sit obediently in a map waiting for him to get off the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡听见，睁开眼笑了一下，没跟着添话。塔维也笑，随后想起自己在白老师台子边讲要去看水，讲得倒像水会乖乖待在一张图里，等他下车来看。

pairs.target: tāmen yèlǐ zhù zài lùpáng kèdiàn , chuāngwài yǒu wāshēng , lí dé jìn , xiàng shuí bǎ shēngyīn gē jìn le shuǐpén .
pairs.english: They stayed at a roadside inn that night. Frogs called close outside the window, as if someone had put their voices in a water basin.
pairs.hanzi: 他们夜里住在路旁客店，窗外有蛙声，离得近，像谁把声音搁进了水盆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bànyè xǐnglái yícì , xiān mō bēibāo wài de yóubù , mō dào gān de cái yòu shuì xià .
pairs.english: Tavi woke once at midnight, felt the oilcloth outside his pack, and slept again only after finding it dry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维半夜醒来一次，先摸背包外的油布，摸到干的才又睡下。

pairs.target: qīngzǎo xiàlóu , ruǎn héng yǐjīng chī guò bànwǎn zhōu , miànqián gēzhe lǎobǎn jièlái de zhēn , zhèng tiāo yīxiù lǐ yìgēn zhā rén de suì xiàn .
pairs.english: Downstairs early, he found Ruan Heng halfway through porridge, a needle borrowed from the innkeeper in front of him, picking an irritating thread out of his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 清早下楼，阮衡已经吃过半碗粥，面前搁着老板借来的针，正挑衣袖里一根扎人的碎线。

pairs.target: " míngrì jiāo guò rén , wǒ biàn wǎnghuí zǒu . " tā shuō , " dù chéng hái děng nà jǐbǐ fǎn yùnshù . "
pairs.english: “After handing you over tomorrow, I'll head back,” he said. “Du Cheng still needs those return-freight figures.”
pairs.hanzi: “明日交过人，我便往回走。”他说，“杜澄还等那几笔返运数。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , hūrán yǒuxiē bù xíguàn . qián jǐhuí líkāi xuégōng , ruǎn héng de xiāngzǐ zǒng zài chēshàng , zìjǐ búwèn yě zhīdào wǎnshàng huìtóng shuí zhù yìjiān diàn .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, suddenly unsettled. On previous departures from the academy Ruan Heng's box had always been in the cart; without asking he knew who'd share his inn that night.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，忽然有些不习惯。前几回离开学宫，阮衡的箱子总在车上，自己不问也知道晚上会同谁住一间店。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng shuō duō liú yìtiān yě bùfáng , huà méi chūkǒu , ruǎn héng xiān jiāng suì xiàn tiāochūlái , jǔ gěi tā kàn , jūrán bǐ yìgēn jiémáo hái duǎn .
pairs.english: He wanted to say another day wouldn't hurt, but before he spoke Ruan Heng held up the offending thread: shorter than an eyelash.
pairs.hanzi: 他想说多留一天也不妨，话没出口，阮衡先将碎线挑出来，举给他看，居然比一根睫毛还短。

pairs.target: " zuóyè zhǎo le bàntiān . " tā shuō , yǔqì dǎo bǐ tán tuōjià shí gèng bùfú .
pairs.english: “Took half last night to find it,” he said, sounding more aggrieved than when discussing cradles.
pairs.hanzi: “昨夜找了半天。”他说，语气倒比谈托架时更不服。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù xiào , gāngcái nà yìdiǎn méishuōchū de niàntou yě sōng le . tā bǎ zìjǐ nà wǎn zhōu chī wán , duānwǎn qù hái , méi liúgěi ruǎn héng tì tā shōu .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't help laughing; the unspoken thought eased too. He finished his porridge and returned the bowl himself, not leaving it for Ruan Heng to clear.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住笑，刚才那一点没说出的念头也松了。他把自己那碗粥吃完，端碗去还，没留给阮衡替他收。

pairs.target: cìrì xiàwǔ , bái péng yì de péngdǐng cóng lùbiān yìpái liǔshù hòu lùchū lái . báisè bìng bù xuěliàng , jìn kàn shì shài jiù de wěixí , bǔ le jǐchù xīn xí , shēnqiǎn xiāngjiàn .
pairs.english: The next afternoon White Awning Station's roof appeared behind roadside willows. Its white wasn't brilliant: weathered reed mats patched with newer ones in alternating shades.
pairs.hanzi: 次日下午，白棚驿的棚顶从路边一排柳树后露出来。白色并不雪亮，近看是晒旧的苇席，补了几处新席，深浅相间。

pairs.target: chēfū shōu hǎo chēqián , zhǐ gěi tāmen zhùsù de yuànmén , suíhòu gǎnzhe kōng chūlái de zuòwèi qù jiē lìng yì bō kèrén .
pairs.english: The driver collected their fares, pointed out the lodging courtyard, then took the emptied seats to collect another group of passengers.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫收好车钱，指给他们住宿的院门，随后赶着空出来的座位去接另一拨客人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bēibāo xiàchē , xiédǐ tà dào yìxiǎokuài ruǎnní , fāchū de shēngxiǎng tóng fēng zhàn de shí jiē wánquán bùtóng .
pairs.english: Tavi shouldered his pack and stepped down into soft mud, its sound completely unlike Wind Trestle's stone streets.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维背包下车，鞋底踏到一小块软泥，发出的声响同风栈的石街完全不同。

pairs.target: nài lěi hái méi dào , tāmen zǎo lái le yìtiān . yì fánglǐ de rén chá dào liúgěi tā de nà fēng xuégōng láixìn , lìng yǒu yìzhāng tā xiānjì dào de zhùsù biàntiáo , xiě zhe míngrì shàngwǔ huìmiàn .
pairs.english: Nerai hadn't arrived; they were a day early. Station staff found the academy letter held for her, plus her advance lodging note arranging a meeting the next morning.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾还没到，他们早来了一天。驿房里的人查到留给她的那封学宫来信，另有一张她先寄到的住宿便条，写着明日上午会面。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng dú guò , biàn tóng tā bǎ bāo fàngjìn yuànlǐ nà jiān yǒu chuāng de kèfáng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng read it, then put their bags with him in the courtyard's windowed guest room.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡读过，便同他把包放进院里那间有窗的客房。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yìzhī chángjiǎo niǎo luò zài shuǐgōu biān , zuǐlǐ diāo zhe shénme , chíchí bùkěn tūn .
pairs.english: Outside, a long-legged bird landed by the ditch, holding something in its beak and taking its time swallowing.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外一只长脚鸟落在水沟边，嘴里叼着什么，迟迟不肯吞。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le yíhuìer , cái bǎ túbǎn gē dào bù dǎng rén zǒulù de qiángbiān . tā méiyǒu xiān huà niǎo , xiān bǎ xiédǐ de ní guā le .
pairs.english: Tavi watched a while before placing his board against the wall out of people's way. He didn't draw the bird first; he scraped the mud off his soles.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了一会儿，才把图板搁到不挡人走路的墙边。他没有先画鸟，先把鞋底的泥刮了。
